method.tools: six fixed requests through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with two tools declared; a check passes when the server returns what an agent framework needs (structured tool_calls, a used tool result, two calls in one turn, no false call, a streamed call, an exact path argument)
method.loop: a growing agent transcript replayed turn by turn; warm lets the server reuse its prefix cache, cold salts the system prompt so every turn is prefilled from scratch; output length is forced with ignore_eos
method.shapes: synthetic = a 600-word system prompt plus sixteen ~1.2K-token tool results, 128 tokens out per turn; typical and heavy = real Claude Code sessions from usage.json replayed at their recorded context and output sizes, turns that do not fit the server's window skipped and counted
method.warmup: one short turn before each configuration's runs, so compilation is not charged to turn 1
